history.title: History of Tanza
history.charteredDesc: Originally known as Santa Cruz de Malabon, Tanza was founded in 1760 and renamed on February 28, 1914.
history.populationDesc: Population grew from 226,188 (2015) to 339,308 (2024) across 41 barangays.

founded.title: Founded as Santa Cruz de Malabon
founded.text: The town of Santa Cruz de Malabon is founded on the Cavite coast.

oath.title: Aguinaldo takes his oath of office
oath.text: After the Tejeros Convention, Emilio Aguinaldo and the other elected officials, except Andres Bonifacio, take their oath of office in Santa Cruz de Malabon, now Tanza.

annexed.title: Annexed to San Francisco de Malabon
annexed.text: On October 15, 1903, Act No. 947 annexes Santa Cruz de Malabon to the neighboring town of San Francisco de Malabon, now General Trias.

renamed.title: Renamed to Tanza
renamed.text: Legislative Act No. 2390 renames Santa Cruz de Malabon to Tanza on February 28, 1914, the name it carries to this day.

terminal.title: Cavite Gateway Terminal opens
terminal.text: Tanza hosts the Cavite Gateway Terminal, the first roll-on, roll-off barge terminal in the Philippines.

mall.title: SM City Tanza opens
mall.text: SM City Tanza opens on October 14, 2022 along Antero Soriano Highway in Barangay Daang Amaya 2, the first SM Supermall in Tanza.

recognition.title: DILG Seals of Good Governance
recognition.text: The DILG awards Tanza the Seal of Good Financial Housekeeping in 2011, 2012, 2018, 2019 and 2021, and the Seal of Good Local Governance in 2016.
